hypothesis: A tokenless causal program inferred from public real one-bit interventions, with unknown causal input roles and an unknown 3-input hidden-state update truth table, outperforms fully fitted conventional recurrent learners on three-step open-loop forecasts while preserving familiar and out-of-family accuracy.
mechanism: Hidden z update: z_(t+1) = z_t XOR table(x_a,x_b,x_c), public output y_t = z_t XOR x_k,t, with a,b,c,k unknown and pairwise distinct; actual intervention changes one public input bit and results in y_(t+1). Candidate infers an 8-bit truth table and unknown roles from public before/after x,y pairs; 3-step forecast receives y0, x0, exact actual actions but not intermediate outputs.

source.roles: For fixture/phase/world: rank i in 0..7 by SHA256 ASCII 'AAI12W|fixture|phase|world|role|i'; first 3 are 3input roles in that order and 4th is output XOR port k. Familiar uses first 2 roles and k=third; negative uses first 4 roles and k=fifth.
source.train: Rank n in 0..255 by SHA256('AAI12W|fixture|phase|world|x|n') ascending; 48 distinct first x as training predecessor states; train action flip index = SHA256('AAI12W|fixture|phase|world|train-action|n') first eight bytes mod8, train y0 first SHA256('AAI12W|fixture|phase|world|train-y|n') byte LSB. A real one-bit do updates x to xnext, hidden z and public y using hidden recurrent transition.
source.evaluation: From remaining ranked x, admit first 64 where all three predecessor states under deterministic actual do flips are outside 48 training x. Each step flip index = SHA256('AAI12W|fixture|phase|world|eval-action|n|step') first eight bytes mod8. Initial observed y0 = SHA256('AAI12W|fixture|phase|world|eval-y|n') byte LSB. Learner sees x0,y0, 3 actual do actions, predicts final y3 without intermediate outputs.

models.candidate: Enumerate k in 0..7, and ordered triples (a,b,c) chosen from 7 other input dimensions; derive observed update bit y XOR ynext XOR x[k] XOR xnext[k]. Fit a binary table for each of 8 three-input cells using deterministic majority vote (unseen cells 0), rank by train mismatch, descending covered cells, then lexicographic k,a,b,c,mask. Retain only one program with 8-bit table, four input roles, public evidence digest.
models.baseline_id3: Fully fitted ID3 depth7 over 17 binary features = current x eight, next x eight, current y; deterministic entropy/gain, no hidden truth. Recursive three-step prediction.
models.baseline_logistic: Full batch 200-epoch logistic with intercept + 17 binary features + 136 pair products, learning rate .4, L2 .01, zero init; recur predicted y over 3 actions.
models.baseline_knn: k=5 nearest full public 17-bit feature over all 48 fitted rows, tie order by row index; recursive y prediction.
models.baseline_pair_grammar: Fit k and two ordered distinct causal input roles, six fixed 2-input operators XOR AND OR NAND NOR XNOR on same recurrence target; choose min training mismatch and lexicographic tie; recurse.
models.baseline_persistence: Always return last known y, a no-learning negative control.
models.capacity: All models see the same 48 public transitions per world. Candidate retained state is 8-bit relation plus at most four roles, and public source digest. Controls may retain their exact learned trees/weights/rows.
models.cold: Canonical JSON checkpoint/restore for every method before first heldout forecast. No model sees hidden roles, hidden z, source law or oracle. Exact SHA and deterministic repeated source-only screen.

gates.stop: Run one frozen source-only screen after code/tests committed. Any miss => DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE and no post-result tuning/first-use.

invalid_if: Any hidden role/mask/oracle exposed to learner, fewer than 64 test contexts, training/test predecessor-state overlap, model-specific data/action budget, corrupt cold serialization or changed source after outcome.
interpretation: Positive source-only development is not independent science, unrestricted primitive invention, general intelligence, or authorized native integration.
